#Import Libraries

Import the Libraries needed for the relevant vver-representation analysis.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(patchwork)
        
Figure_Export <- file.path(here(),"Figures")

Data_Import <- file.path(here(), "Data")

```


#Import the Differential Expression of Genes for each of the 4 datasets and Extract the Significant results

Import the Differential Gene Expression for each of the 4 datasets in the same format that Xiong et al 2020 performed (TCGA-LUAD was done on DESeq2 while the GEO datasets were performed using limma) and perform relevant filtering for significant differentially expressed genes in each dataset.

```{r}
#Import Results
TCGA_LUAD_results <- readRDS(file.path(Data_Import, "TCGA-LUAD_DEG_results.rds"))

GSE43458_DEG_results <- readRDS(file.path(Data_Import, "GSE43458_DEG_results.rds"))

GSE10072_DEG_results <- readRDS(file.path(Data_Import, "GSE10072_DEG_results.rds"))

GSE32863_DEG_results <- readRDS(file.path(Data_Import, "GSE32863_DEG_results.rds"))

#Filter out non-significant Genes

List_of_results <- list(TCGA_LUAD_results, GSE43458_DEG_results, GSE10072_DEG_results, GSE32863_DEG_results)

#For Loop to filter out the non-significant genes
for (i in 1:length(List_of_results)) {
  
  Data <- List_of_results[[i]] #Extract each dataset for the loop
  
  Data <- as.data.frame(Data) #Ensure its in the format of a dataframe
  
  Data <- Data %>% #Filter out genes that have "No Significance"
    filter(Significance != "No Significance") %>%
    rownames_to_column(., var = "Gene_Symbol")
  
  #print(Data)
  
  List_of_results[[i]] <- Data #Add the new set back to the List
 
}

#Extract the results for each dataframe in the list to extract only the significant genes
TCGA_LUAD_results <- List_of_results[[1]]

GSE43458_DEG_results <- List_of_results[[2]]

GSE10072_DEG_results <- List_of_results[[3]]

GSE32863_DEG_results <- List_of_results[[4]]

#Remove this object
rm(Data)
```


#Extract the Significant Genes based on whether they are Up-regulated or Downregulated

This splitting can be done with split() in Base R or nest() in dplyr, but each dataframe will be split into another list based on whether they are upregulated or downregulated. They will be extracted so they can be compared to each other to look for genes that were upregulated or downregulated respectively in all 4 datasets.

```{r}
#Split each dataframe into a list with 2 dataframes determined by whether the genes were upregulated or downregulated
TCGA_LUAD_results <- split(TCGA_LUAD_results, TCGA_LUAD_results$Significance)

GSE10072_DEG_results <- split(GSE10072_DEG_results, GSE10072_DEG_results$Significance)

GSE32863_DEG_results <- split(GSE32863_DEG_results, GSE32863_DEG_results$Significance)

GSE43458_DEG_results <- split(GSE43458_DEG_results, GSE43458_DEG_results$Significance)
```

#Isolate the List of Genes 

The next step will identify whether a gene that is upregulated or downregulated is present in all 4 datasets as upregulated or downregulated respectively. A Venn Diagram will not be created as the authors of Xiong et al 2020 created, but the Genes that were found in all 4 datasets will be isolated.

```{r}
###Identify the Down regulated Genes in all of the data sets

#Choose any of the data sets, of which the largest was chosen, as the basis to check all the other datasets. 
Downregulated_Genes <- TCGA_LUAD_results[["Downregulated"]][["Gene_Symbol"]]

#Create a logical vector equal to the length of that data set
Gene_Check <- logical(length(Downregulated_Genes))

#GSE NCBI GEO Dataset Downregulated Genes
GSE32863 <- GSE32863_DEG_results[["Downregulated"]][["Gene_Symbol"]]
GSE10072 <- GSE10072_DEG_results[["Downregulated"]][["Gene_Symbol"]]
GSE43458 <- GSE43458_DEG_results[["Downregulated"]][["Gene_Symbol"]]

#Create a loop to check for each Gene Symbol in the Downregulated_Genes set is in each of the others
for (i in seq_along(Downregulated_Genes)){

  #Extracts the Gene in LUAD
  Symbol = Downregulated_Genes[i]
  
  #Check to see if its in all of the other 3 datasets and if the Gene is, the logical becomes true, if not it becomes false
  Gene_Check[i] <- all(Symbol %in% GSE32863, 
                                Symbol %in% GSE10072,
                                Symbol %in% GSE43458)
}

#Filter the Downregulated Genes using the logical based on whether the gene is also in each of the other 3 datasets.
Downregulated_Genes <- Downregulated_Genes[Gene_Check]



### Identify the Upregulated Genes in all of the datasets

Upregulated_Genes <- TCGA_LUAD_results[["Upregulated"]][["Gene_Symbol"]]

Gene_Check_Upreg <- logical(length(Upregulated_Genes))

#GSE NCBI GEO Dataset Upregulated Genes
GSE32863_up <- GSE32863_DEG_results[["Upregulated"]][["Gene_Symbol"]]
GSE10072_up <- GSE10072_DEG_results[["Upregulated"]][["Gene_Symbol"]]
GSE43458_up <- GSE43458_DEG_results[["Upregulated"]][["Gene_Symbol"]]

for (i in seq_along(Upregulated_Genes)){

  #Extracts the Gene in LUAD
  Symbol = Upregulated_Genes[i]
  
  #Check to see if its in all of the other 3 datasets
  Gene_Check_Upreg[i] <- all(Symbol %in% GSE32863_up, 
                                Symbol %in% GSE10072_up,
                                Symbol %in% GSE43458_up)
}

#Select the Upregulated Genes
Upregulated_Genes <- Upregulated_Genes[Gene_Check_Upreg]

#Save the Upregulated and Downregulated Gene List
writeLines(Upregulated_Genes, file.path(Data_Import, "Upregulated_Genes.txt"))

writeLines(Downregulated_Genes, file.path(Data_Import, "Downregulated_Genes.txt"))
```


#Run Over Representation Analysis on Upregulated Genes

Now that a list of genes was identified that was differentially upregulated in all 4 datasets, over-representation analysis will be performed.

```{r}
#Run the Enrichment analysis using Clusterprofiler enrichGO() function where it pulls the enrichment list that was predownloaded.
Upregulated_Gene_Ontology <- enrichGO(gene = Upregulated_Genes,
                                      OrgDb = 'org.Hs.eg.db',
                                      keyType = "SYMBOL",
                                      pool = FALSE,
                                      ont = "ALL",
                                      pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                                      pvalueCutoff = 0.05)

Upregulated_Gene_Ontology <- as.data.frame(Upregulated_Gene_Ontology)

#Upregulated Gene Ontology Graph
Upregulated_Gene_Ontology %>%
  mutate(ordered_pval = -log10(p.adjust)) %>%
  group_by(ONTOLOGY) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = fct_reorder(Description, ordered_pval), y = -log10(p.adjust), color = ONTOLOGY))+
  geom_point(size = 3)+
  facet_wrap(~ONTOLOGY, nrow = 3, ncol = 1, scales = "free",
             strip.position = "right")+
  labs(x = "", title = "Upregulated Genes: Gene Ontology")+
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),
        axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"))+
    coord_flip()+
  ylim(1,7)

#Save the Graph
ggsave(filename = file.path(Figure_Export, "Overrepresentation_Analysis_Upregulated.png"),
       width = 8, height = 5)
  
```

#Run Over Representation Analysis on Downregulated Genes

Now that a list of genes was identified that were differentially downregulated in all 4 datasets, over-representation analysis will be performed.

```{r}
#Run the Enrichment analysis using Clusterprofiler enrichGO() function where it pulls the enrichment list that was predownloaded.
```

#Run Enrichment on the Differentally Expressed Genes as a whole

```{r}
#Combine Vectors
Genes_Overall <- c(Upregulated_Genes, Downregulated_Genes)
#Look for Duplicate Genes
Duplicated <- duplicated(Genes_Overall) 
#Filter out duplicates
Genes_Overall <- Genes_Overall[Duplicated == FALSE]

#There were no duplicates which shouldn't be surprising since if a gene is upregulated, it can't be downregulated.

Gene_Ontology_Overall <- enrichGO(gene = Genes_Overall,
                                      OrgDb = 'org.Hs.eg.db',
                                      keyType = "SYMBOL",
                                      pool = FALSE,
                                      ont = "ALL",
                                      pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                                      pvalueCutoff = 0.05)

Gene_Ontology_Overall <- as.data.frame(Gene_Ontology_Overall)

#Arrange by Genes in that grouping
Gene_Ontology_Overall <- Gene_Ontology_Overall %>%
  mutate(ONTOLOGY = case_when(ONTOLOGY == "BP" ~ "Biological Processes",
    ONTOLOGY == "MF" ~ "Molecular Function",
    ONTOLOGY == "CC" ~ "Cellular Component",
    TRUE ~ "NA")) %>%
  group_by(ONTOLOGY) %>%
  arrange(desc(-log(p.adjust)))

#Reproduced Graph 2B
Gene_Ontology_Overall %>%
  mutate(ordered_pval = -log10(p.adjust)) %>%
  group_by(ONTOLOGY) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = fct_reorder(Description, ordered_pval), y = -log10(p.adjust), color = ONTOLOGY))+
  geom_point(size = 3)+
  facet_wrap(~ONTOLOGY, nrow = 3, ncol = 1, scales = "free",
             strip.position = "right")+
  labs(x = "", title = "Gene Ontology")+
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),
        axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"))+
    coord_flip()+
  ylim(1,7)

ggsave(filename = file.path(Figure_Export, "Overrepresentation_Analysis_Combined_Fig2B.png"),
       width = 8, height = 5)
  
```

# Run Over-representation Analysis on the overall differentially expressed gene set overall with KEGG

```{r}
#Choose Genes Overall which is already filtered
glimpse(Genes_Overall)

#Run Enrichment on KEGG (Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes)
KEGG_enrich <- enrichKEGG(gene = Gene_Overall,
           organism = 'org.Hs.eg.db',
            keyType = "ncbi-geneid",
            pAdjustMethod = "BH",
            pvalueCutoff = 0.05)

#Since the above connection does not work, the manual KEGG gmt file will be used that was downloaded from the Broad Institute Website here
#[https://data.broadinstitute.org/gsea-msigdb/msigdb/release/7.0/]

kegg_file <- read.gmt(gmtfile = file.path(Data_Import, "c2.cp.kegg.v7.0.symbols.gmt"))

#Run manual KEGG enrichment

KEGG_enrich <- enricher(
  gene = Genes_Overall,
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  TERM2GENE = kegg_file)

KEGG_enrich <- as.data.frame(KEGG_enrich)

KEGG_enrich %>%
  mutate(ordered_pval = -log10(p.adjust)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = fct_reorder(Description, ordered_pval), y = -log10(p.adjust)))+
  geom_point(size = 3)+
  coord_flip()+
  labs(x = "", title = "KEGG")+
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),
        axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, color = "black"))+
    coord_flip()+
  ylim(1,5)

ggsave(filename = file.path(Figure_Export, "Overrepresentation_Analysis_Combined_KEGG_Fig2C.png"),
       width = 8, height = 5)

```
